description: In JStock, remove the stocks GOOGL (Alphabet) and AMZN (Amazon) from the default watchlist 'My Watchlist'. The watchlist currently contains 5 stocks: AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, and NVDA. After completing the task, only AAPL, MSFT, and NVDA should remain in the watchlist. The country is set to United States. Use the JStock application interface to select and delete these two stocks. Ensure the changes are saved so that the watchlist file at ~/.jstock/1.0.7/UnitedState/watchlist/My Watchlist/realtimestock.csv reflects the removal.
